prompt:

The diagonal unfolded head occupies the upper 560×540 part, a tiny separate nape rectangle is in the lower left (x=0 to 190 y=540 to 675), and the lower right is blank gray. Keep exactly this image's tall aspect ratio, all original UV island positions, outline, orientation and sizes. Ignore the second image's geometry, face, colors and hat; it is ONLY an example of clean hard-edge pixel clusters.
Invent an unrelated younger adult Balkan man with full short sharply tapered black-brown beard, tidy dark moustache, short nearly black hair and higher-temple sideburns. His brows are dark, thick and slightly softer than a frown. Warm brown skin with a naturally slightly weathered look, subdued nose and cheek shading, lips muted. Compared to the original diffuse texture, draw the beard distinctly darker and denser and replace the skin shading with deliberate pixel clusters, without widening the actual beard across ears, dark eye holes, mouth opening or collar. Design dark interlocking stepped clusters, slight muted russet highlights only in the hair, no gray streaks. Give him a visibly different identity by drawing new eyebrow, cheek and beard contours while preserving the fixed latitude of eyes and mouth so the real model still aligns. Eyes themselves are separate materials; leave the two existing black eye cutouts with neutral dark edges and no drawn eyeballs. Lower-left rectangular nape panel must match the same near-black short hair and preserve its original shape, collar and skin strip exactly. Bold illustrated 1990s pixel art with clearly stepped square clusters, 4–6 shades per material and softly tonal hair, no gradients, outlines around UV islands, no text, no framing. Keep unchanged gray outside the artwork and no standing figure.
preparation: Iz FBX-a u Blenderu izvesti originalnu ugrađenu teksturu tela texture.jpg (2048 × 2048). Pokrenuti python -B assets/images/sources/cetnici/cetnik-subara-pixel-art/prepare.py <putanja-do-texture.jpg> uz Pillow, NumPy i SciPy. Skripta uklapa lice u postojeći UV raspored, čuva boje uniforme i izvozi lossless WebP od 1024 × 1024.
